commercialModel.status: Founding price · £29 a month or £290 a year
commercialModel.subscription: The founding workspace is £29 a month or £290 a year for one organisation. Team is £79 a month for five people. Business is £199 a month for fifteen. No VAT is added.
commercialModel.subscriptionBoundary: Checkout charges these prices only. Model use is billed by the customer's own provider.
commercialModel.customProjects: Discovery, integrations and bespoke implementation are proposed and priced separately.
commercialModel.partnerAccess: KXRA may issue auditable free partner access without creating a paid subscription.
commercialModel.taxBoundary: KXRA is not VAT registered, so VAT is not currently added to the stated price. Any future chargeable tax will be configured and shown before payment.
commercialModel.usageBoundary: Custom engagements require an agreed scope and price. External AI execution requires configured providers and usage limits.
